sourceDecision: Retain production. MetadataTable imports SortHeader/useSort, initializes sorting with columns[0].key and maps the exact item.key into onClick={() => toggle(item.key)}. SortHeader receives label={item.label}, active={sortKey === item.key} and dir={sortDir}; its onClick parameter is declared () => void and passed directly as onClick={onClick} to a literal native button. The complete opening button tag declares onClick, aria-label and className; it declares no type, disabled, role, tabIndex, aria-pressed or custom keyboard event attribute. No browser defaults, form submission, focus or keyboard/announcement/AT behavior is qualified by these declarations. The label remains Sort by column label with the current ascending/descending suffix only when active. No callback, hook, comparator, sort or render is invoked. Targeted saved metadata-announcements and metadata-success declaration selections omit MetadataTable/SortHeader and substitute a props-only metadata-table or string placeholder. Selected saved role/aria-live assertions concern synthetic table props; they do not qualify real sort-control attributes or events. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
